name: tickdb/tickdb-unified-realtime-marketdata-api
description: An AI-native real-time market data API for US/HK/CN stocks, forex, futures, crypto, indices, and commodities, with a Skill and CLI interface so agents can query live market data directly.
install: npx clawhub@latest install tickdb-market-data for the skill (AI auto-fetches a trial key), plus python -m pip install -e . for the API package
